how_to_fill: Fill empty "khmer" fields. Do not rename keys or change "english".
Keep placeholders {{likeThis}} and {0} unchanged inside Khmer text.

Keep HTML tags (, ,
) in math patterns and pointsOffScale; translate only surrounding words if any.

PRIORITY 1 — sim_visible_ui: title, Explore/Generic screens, checkboxes, distance modes, scene object names, unit words, distance-description sentences, Preferences→Simulation Terminology (all EMPTY — please translate).
PRIORITY 1b — common_visible_ui: Generic-screen range labels + "Points off scale!" (EMPTY — please translate). Source: number-line-common.
PRIORITY 2 — shared_joist_chrome / shared_scenery_phet_chrome: PhET menu, About/Credits, Preferences tabs, Reset All (prefilled from number-play — review/adjust).

Screens: Explore (Distance / Temperature / Elevation scenes), Generic. Preferences Simulation tab: Terminology (Directed Distance vs Displacement). No separate Game/practice levels in this sim — Explore is the practice surface.
Math symbols (x, y, A, B) and unit abbreviations (m, °C, E, W) can stay Latin if preferred.
No sim-specific a11y string block in number-line-distance-strings_en.json.
Send this file back when ready; we will apply into babel as *-strings_km.json (+ joist/scenery-phet/number-line-common as needed).

preferences.tabs.general.accessibilityIn.khmer: យើងកំពុងអភិវឌ្ឍមុខងារបន្ថែមក្នុងការពិសោធន៍ ដើម្បីឱ្យអ្នកសិក្សាទាំងអស់អាចចូលរៀនបានកាន់តែងាយស្រួល។ មុខងារមួយចំនួនជួយគាំទ្រដល់ការប្រើប្រាស់របស់អ្នករៀនដែលមានតម្រូវការពិសេស និងស្ថិតក្នុងស្ថានភាពសិក្សាផ្សេងៗគ្នា។ អ្នកអាចចូលទៅកាន់ម៉ឺនុយនេះ ដើម្បីពិនិត្យ ឬកែសម្រួលការកំណត់បង្ហាញទូទៅតាមការចង់បាន។
